【原视频简介】
Enjoy a no-obligation, completely free trial of the Garden Planner here: 
https://www.GrowVeg.com/grow-planner-free

And for your completely free abridged version of Ben's book, click here:
https://www.growveg.com/grow-book-download

To see more of Marv and Char's garden, you can follow their channel here:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgaF2riY92oXA1xPnptfqOw

Or you can check out their website here:
https://plantedinthegarden.com/

Over the years we have filmed quite a few incredible gardens, including some tiny back yards which yield impressive harvests. But this July we hopped across the pond to Canada to visit the most productive tiny garden we've ever filmed, belonging to Marv and Char Lopez of the popular channel Planted in the Garden, based in Ontario. With all sorts of ingenious solutions for growing bumper harvests in a small spaces, this tour will open our eyes to just how much it is possible to grow, in no matter what size space.
metadata.title: 巴掌大的小院竟能种出这么多菜！加拿大夫妻的爆产小菜园｜The Most Productive Tiny Garden We’ve Ever Filmed
